stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: paths
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT __path,CASE WHEN substr(__path,1,4)='api/' THEN substr(__path,5) ELSE __path END AS path FROM nodes

stages.name: decorators
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,d.id,coalesce(c.callee,a.attr,child.text) AS name FROM functions f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=d.__path AND child.parent=d.id LEFT JOIN calls c ON c.__path=child.__path AND c.id=child.id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=child.__path AND a.id=child.id

stages.name: function_symbols
stages.query:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*,coalesce((SELECT group_concat(name,'.')||'.' FROM (SELECT c.name FROM classes c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start<f.__start AND c.__end>=f.__end ORDER BY c.__start)),'')||f.name AS symbol,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorators d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND d.name IN ('direct_legacy_module_async','direct_legacy_module_sync','legacy_async','legacy_module_async','legacy_module_sync','legacy_sync')) AS legacy FROM functions f)

stages.name: active_functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,symbol ORDER BY __start DESC) AS selected FROM function_symbols) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: valid_boundary
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT f.__path FROM functions f JOIN decorators d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id WHERE d.name IN ('legacy_async','legacy_module_async','legacy_module_sync','legacy_sync')
 UNION SELECT DISTINCT f.__path FROM functions f JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=f.__path AND o.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=o.__path AND c.id=o.id AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('run_in_legacy_execution_boundary','run_in_legacy_execution_boundary_async') JOIN functions lazy ON lazy.__path=f.__path AND lazy.name=CASE WHEN substr(f.name,-6)='_async' THEN substr(f.name,1,length(f.name)-6)||'_lazy' ELSE f.name||'_lazy' END

stages.name: receiver_edges
stages.query:
SELECT a.__path,a.object AS src,a.id AS dst FROM attributes a
 UNION SELECT a.__path,a.attribute_kind||':'||a.attribute_start||':'||a.attribute_end,a.id FROM attributes a
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.callee_id,c.id FROM calls c WHERE c.callee!='cast' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id)<2
 UNION SELECT c.__path,a.id,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 WHERE c.callee='cast'
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id AND c.ordinal=0 WHERE n.kind IN ('subscript','parenthesized_expression')

stages.name: receiver_tokens
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE tokens(__path,id,token) AS (SELECT __path,id,lower(text) FROM nodes WHERE kind='identifier' UNION SELECT t.__path,e.dst,t.token FROM tokens t JOIN receiver_edges e ON e.__path=t.__path AND e.src=t.id) SELECT * FROM tokens

stages.name: raw_boundaries
stages.query: SELECT * FROM from_imports WHERE module IN ('l2050_transaction.execution_boundary','l2000_connection.execution_boundary') AND name='legacy_execution_boundary'

stages.name: eager_seeds
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,c.id AS anchor FROM active_functions f JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=f.__path AND o.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=o.__path AND c.id=o.id WHERE NOT f.legacy AND c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('resolve','resolve_async')

stages.name: call_candidates
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS caller,c.id AS anchor,c.callee AS candidate FROM active_functions f JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=f.__path AND o.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=o.__path AND c.id=o.id WHERE NOT f.legacy AND c.callee NOT IN ('resolve','resolve_async','_legacy_delegate_stub','legacy_execution_boundary') AND c.callee NOT IN ('run_in_legacy_execution_boundary','run_in_legacy_execution_boundary_async')
 UNION SELECT f.__path,f.id,c.id,substr(f.symbol,1,length(f.symbol)-length(f.name))||c.callee FROM active_functions f JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=f.__path AND o.fn=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=o.__path AND c.id=o.id JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.id=c.callee_id WHERE NOT f.legacy AND c.callee NOT IN ('resolve','resolve_async') AND a.object_text IN ('self','cls') AND instr(f.symbol,'.')>0

stages.name: resolved_calls
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.caller,c.anchor,min(f.id) AS callee FROM call_candidates c JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=c.__path AND (f.name=c.candidate OR f.symbol=c.candidate) GROUP BY c.__path,c.caller,c.anchor,c.candidate HAVING count(*)=1 AND min(f.id)!=c.caller

stages.name: eager_reach
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE reaches(__path,fn) AS (SELECT __path,fn FROM eager_seeds UNION SELECT r.__path,c.caller FROM reaches r JOIN resolved_calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.callee=r.fn JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.caller WHERE NOT f.legacy) SELECT * FROM reaches

stages.name: eager_anchors
stages.query:
SELECT __path,fn,anchor FROM (
 SELECT e.__path,e.fn,e.anchor,n.__start,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY e.__path,e.fn ORDER BY n.__start,n.__end DESC) AS selected FROM eager_seeds e JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=e.__path AND n.id=e.anchor) WHERE selected=1
 UNION SELECT __path,fn,anchor FROM (
 SELECT c.__path,c.caller AS fn,c.anchor,n.__start,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.caller ORDER BY n.__start,n.__end DESC) AS selected FROM resolved_calls c JOIN eager_reach r ON r.__path=c.__path AND r.fn=c.callee JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.id=c.anchor WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eager_seeds s WHERE s.__path=c.__path AND s.fn=c.caller)) WHERE selected=1
